titulo: What Did Ancient Romans Actually Do All Day?

cenas.texto: Your alarm goes off at six thirty.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: You check your phone, and your whole day is already cut into little boxes.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: Meetings. Deadlines. Lunch at twelve sharp.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: Now rewind about nineteen hundred years, to the biggest city in the Western world.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: Rome, around the year 90 AD. Somewhere between half a million and a million people. Nobody knows exactly.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: Nobody there owns a clock that ticks.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: And yet a Roman poet left us something remarkable: a schedule.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: In a short poem, the poet Martial laid out how a day in Rome was spent, hour by hour.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: So let's borrow his schedule, and live one ordinary day in ancient Rome.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: From the first hour, to the last.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Abertura (gancho: o presente)

cenas.texto: But first, a problem. What exactly is an hour in Rome?
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: For the Romans, daytime ran from sunrise to sunset, and it was always divided into twelve hours.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: Always twelve. No matter the season.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: So in June, when days are long, one Roman hour lasted about seventy-five of our minutes.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: In December, it shrank to about forty-five.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: Your lunch break literally got shorter in winter.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: To tell the time, Romans looked at the sun.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: And for a long time, they did it badly.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: According to Pliny the Elder, the first public sundial in the Roman Forum was war loot, brought back from Catania, in Sicily, in 263 BC.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: There was one small problem. Catania is much further south than Rome.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: So the lines on the dial didn't match the hours in Rome.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: Pliny says the Romans kept following that wrong sundial for ninety-nine years.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: And not everyone loved sundials, even the accurate ones.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: In an old Roman comedy, a hungry character curses the man who invented hours.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: "May the gods destroy the man who first discovered the hours," he says, "and who set up a sundial here, and chopped my day into little pieces."
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: When he was a boy, he says, his belly was his sundial.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: He ate whenever he was hungry. Now he eats when the sun allows it.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: In 159 BC, Rome finally got a water clock, which measured the hours with flowing water, even at night and on cloudy days.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: But most people simply looked at the sky, and listened to the city.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: And the city was loud.
cenas.nome_capitulo: O que era uma hora em Roma

cenas.texto: Our Roman wakes up before sunrise, in a rented room on the third floor of an apartment block.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: The Romans called these blocks insulae: islands.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: They were tall, crowded, and often badly built.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: According to the geographer Strabo, Emperor Augustus limited their height to seventy feet, about twenty-one meters.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: The satirist Juvenal joked that Rome was a city held up by thin wooden props.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Collapses and fires were a constant fear.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: But the everyday enemy was noise.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: By law, most wagons were banned from the city streets from sunrise until the last two hours of daylight.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: So deliveries rolled through the narrow streets at night.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Juvenal complains that in Rome, a good night's sleep costs a fortune.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: And that many sick people in the city die simply from lack of sleep.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: There is no running water in our Roman's room.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Water comes from a public fountain down the street, carried up the stairs in a jar.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: And the toilet? For many people, a chamber pot. Or a walk to a public latrine.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Getting dressed is quick: a simple wool tunic, belted at the waist.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: If he is a citizen with business to do, he also puts on a toga.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: A huge, heavy woolen sheet, very hard to drape properly without help.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Then he steps out into the street, and into the crowd.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Juvenal describes it: a wave of people in front, a mass of people pushing from behind.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: One man jabs you with his elbow, another with a pole. Someone bangs a beam into your head, someone else a wine jar.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Your legs are caked with mud, big feet tread on you from every side, and a soldier's hobnail sticks into your toe.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: On his way, he passes the fountain, full of water that has traveled for miles.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Rome was fed by aqueducts, channels that brought fresh water from the hills, mostly underground and on huge arches.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: The man in charge of them, Frontinus, was very proud of his job.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: He wrote: compare these, if you will, with the idle pyramids, or the useless, though famous, works of the Greeks.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Roman engineers were not modest people.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Acordar numa insula (antes da primeira hora)

cenas.texto: Breakfast was small: some bread, perhaps with cheese, olives or a little salt.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: And many people simply bought it on the street.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: Martial wrote a two-line poem about it.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: "Get up! The baker is already selling breakfast to the boys, and the crested birds of dawn are singing everywhere."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: Those boys were on their way to school.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: And school started early. Very early.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: Martial lived near a schoolmaster, and he hated him.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: "The crested roosters haven't even broken the silence," he wrote, "and you're already thundering with savage shouting and beatings."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: Lessons often happened in a shop or under a porch, open to the street.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: So the whole neighborhood heard every mistake.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Café da manhã e escola

cenas.texto: Now the first hour begins. And Martial tells us exactly what happens.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: "The first and second hour wear out the people paying their morning calls."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: This was the salutatio, the morning greeting.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: Rome ran on a system of patrons and clients.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: A rich patron protected his clients, and helped them with money, jobs and legal trouble.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: In return, the clients gave him something every rich Roman wanted: a crowd.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: So every morning, clients in their togas lined up at his door to wish him good morning.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: The bigger the crowd at your door, the more important you looked.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: The clients were often rewarded with a small handout, called the sportula: the little basket.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: Originally it was food. By Martial's time, it was usually cash.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: Martial and Juvenal both name the amount: a hundred quadrantes.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: The quadrans was the smallest copper coin in Rome. Keep it in mind. It will come back later.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: After the greeting, the clients might follow their patron to the Forum, like a walking advertisement.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: Martial spent years doing this, and complained about it constantly.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Primeira e segunda hora: a salutatio

cenas.texto: "The third hour," says Martial, "keeps the hoarse lawyers busy."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Terceira hora: os tribunais

cenas.texto: Trials were held in the open, in the forums and in the great basilicas.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Terceira hora: os tribunais

cenas.texto: And the speeches were timed. With water clocks.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Terceira hora: os tribunais

cenas.texto: Pliny the Younger, a lawyer and senator, wrote that in one big trial before the Senate he spoke for almost five hours.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Terceira hora: os tribunais

cenas.texto: He had been given twelve water clocks of speaking time, and four more were added.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Terceira hora: os tribunais

cenas.texto: Big trials drew crowds, like a show.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Terceira hora: os tribunais

cenas.texto: Pliny also complained that some speakers hired people to sit in the audience and applaud.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Terceira hora: os tribunais

cenas.texto: Paid applause. Two thousand years before the laugh track.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Terceira hora: os tribunais

cenas.texto: "Until the fifth hour," Martial continues, "Rome stretches out her many kinds of work."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: And most Romans did work. Hard.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: The city was full of tabernae: small shops opening straight onto the street.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Often, the family that ran the shop lived in a room above it or behind it.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Bakers, butchers, shoemakers, barbers, blacksmiths, all side by side.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: The barber's shop was a place to sit, shave and catch up on the gossip.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: But Roman barbers had no fine steel safety razors, and some were famously slow.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Martial wrote about one barber who worked so slowly that, by the time he'd gone round his client's face, a new beard had grown.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Behind much of this work were people who never appear in Martial's schedule.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Many of the cooks, porters, bath attendants and shop workers of Rome were enslaved.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Their day ended when someone else decided it did.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Some of the busiest workers were the fullers, who washed and finished wool cloth.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Their secret ingredient was urine.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: It was collected in jars, then workers standing in tubs stomped it into the cloth with their feet.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Urine was so valuable that Emperor Vespasian put a tax on it.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: His son Titus found this disgusting.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: So, according to the historian Suetonius, Vespasian held a coin from the first payment under his son's nose, and asked if it smelled.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Titus said no.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: "And yet," said Vespasian, "it comes from urine."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Lunch was quick and light, often eaten standing up.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: And for that, there were street bars.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: In Pompeii, a small town south of Rome buried by Vesuvius in 79 AD, archaeologists have found many of these counters.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: In 2020, they finished excavating one that still had its bright paintings.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Ducks, a rooster, a dog, and a sea nymph riding a sea horse.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: In the jars set into the counter, they found the remains of duck, pig, goat, fish and snails.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Fast food, nearly two thousand years ago.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: And on almost everything, Romans poured garum: a sauce made from fermented fish.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Pliny the Elder describes it as fish guts and leftover parts, soaked in salt until they turned to liquid.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Sounds terrible. But modern fish sauce is made in a very similar way, and you might have some in your kitchen.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: And not every morning was the same.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Their official calendar didn't run on our seven-day week. It ran on a market cycle of eight days.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Every eighth day was the nundinae, market day.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Farmers came into town to sell their produce, and to hear about new laws.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: Instead of Monday, the Romans had market day.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Até a quinta hora: o trabalho

cenas.texto: "The sixth hour," says Martial, "is rest for the tired."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sexta hora: o descanso

cenas.texto: Around midday, the city slowed down. People ate, and many took a nap.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sexta hora: o descanso

cenas.texto: And that habit left a mark that still exists today.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sexta hora: o descanso

cenas.texto: The sixth hour, in Latin, is sexta hora.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sexta hora: o descanso

cenas.texto: In Spanish, it became siesta.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sexta hora: o descanso

cenas.texto: "The seventh," Martial says, "will be the end."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: For many Romans, the working day was over by early afternoon.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: Time to walk around, meet friends, and read the walls.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: Because Roman walls talked.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: In Pompeii alone, archaeologists have recorded thousands of painted notices and scratched graffiti.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: There were election posters, painted in big red letters.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: One candidate, Marcus Cerrinius Vatia, was supported by "all the late drinkers."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: Another poster for him came from "the little thieves."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: Some historians suspect his rivals painted those ones.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: There were visitors leaving their mark.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: "Gaius Pumidius Dipilus was here," dated to the third of October, 78 BC.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: There was a very honest review, scratched on a wall by a doorway, and addressed to the host.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: "We wet the bed, host. I admit it, we did wrong. If you want to know why: there was no chamber pot."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: And there was one graffito, found in several places in Pompeii, that says it all.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: "I'm amazed, O wall, that you haven't collapsed under the weight of so many boring writers."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Sétima hora: fim do trabalho e os muros que falam

cenas.texto: "The eighth hour, until the ninth, belongs to the oiled-up wrestling grounds," says Martial.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: In other words: it's bath time.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: The public baths were the heart of Roman social life.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: And they were cheap. Entry could cost a single quadrans.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: Remember the hundred coins from the morning handout? One of them buys you a bath.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: First, exercise: running, wrestling, ball games, lifting weights.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: Then the rooms: the warm room, the hot room, and the cold pool.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: And who went to the baths? Almost everyone. Men and women.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: In many baths, they went at different times.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: A bronze tablet from a Roman mining town in what is now Portugal lists the rules of its baths.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: Women bathe from the first hour to the seventh. Men from the eighth hour until two hours after dark.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: And the price? Men paid half an as. Women paid a whole as. Double.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: There was no soap as we know it.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: Romans covered themselves in oil and scraped it off with a curved metal tool called a strigil.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: Oil, sweat and dirt, all in one go.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: And the baths were loud.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: We know exactly how loud, because the philosopher Seneca once lived right above one.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: He described the noise in a letter.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: The grunts of men lifting lead weights.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: The slap of the masseur's hands on someone's shoulders.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: A ball player counting his score out loud.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: The man who sings in the bath, because he loves the sound of his own voice.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: The splash of people jumping into the pool.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: The hair-plucker, shrieking to attract customers, and only going quiet when he made someone else scream instead.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: And the sellers of sausages, pastries and drinks, each with his own special cry.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: Seneca insisted that a true philosopher could ignore all of this.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: And then, at the end of the very same letter, he admits he's moving out.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: The baths also had public latrines: long rows of stone seats, side by side, with no walls between them.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: Instead of toilet paper, Seneca mentions a sponge on a stick, kept in the latrine for wiping.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: Quite possibly shared.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Oitava e nona hora: as termas

cenas.texto: "The ninth hour," Martial writes, "orders us to crush the piled-up couches."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Dinner time. The cena, the main meal of the day.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: In wealthy homes, guests lay on couches arranged around a low table, three to a couch, leaning on the left elbow.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: A Roman dinner could last for hours.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: The Romans even had an expression for a full meal: from the egg to the apples.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Eggs to start. Fruit to finish. And everything in between.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: And Roman hosts took it personally when you didn't show up.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Pliny the Younger once wrote a mock-angry letter to a friend who accepted his dinner invitation and never came.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: He listed everything that went to waste: a lettuce each, three snails, two eggs, olives, beets, onions.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: And entertainment: a reader, an actor, or a lyre player.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Instead, the friend went to another house for oysters, sea urchins and Spanish dancers.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Honestly, it's hard to blame him.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: And in one Roman novel, a ridiculously rich man called Trimalchio has a clock in his dining room.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: And a trumpeter, to announce how much of his life he has just lost.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Even in fiction, the Romans were a little obsessed with time.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: But most Romans were not rich.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Many apartments had no real kitchen. Fire on the third floor of a building held up by props was a terrible idea.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: So ordinary people ate simply: porridge, bread, beans, vegetables, and cheap wine mixed with water.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Or a hot meal from the street bar on the corner.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: And the tenth hour? Martial has a special plan for it.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: "The tenth hour," he writes, "is the hour for my little books."
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: He's hoping the emperor will read his poems at dinner, relaxed, with a cup of wine in his hand.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: A whole poem about the Roman day, and it ends with a sales pitch.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: Some things never change.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Nona e décima hora: o jantar

cenas.texto: But this was an ordinary working day. And Rome had a lot of days that were not ordinary.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: Dozens of days a year were public festivals, many with free shows paid for by the state or by rich politicians.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: Plays at the theater. Gladiators at the amphitheater.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: And the biggest show of all: the chariot races at the Circus Maximus.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: Ancient writers say it held somewhere between a hundred and fifty and two hundred and fifty thousand spectators.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: The fans were divided into teams, by color: the Reds, the Whites, the Greens and the Blues.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: Not everyone was a fan. Pliny the Younger spent race days at home, writing, and was proud of it.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: He couldn't understand why thousands of grown men wanted to watch horses run, again and again.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: They don't even care about the horses, he wrote. They cheer for a piece of cloth.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: If the drivers swapped colors in the middle of the race, the fans would swap with them.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: Sound familiar?
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: Juvenal had a darker view.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: The Roman people, he wrote, used to hand out armies and offices.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: Now they only long for two things: bread, and circuses.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Dias de folga: pão e circo

cenas.texto: And then, the sun goes down.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: Rome has no street lights.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: The streets are pitch dark. Rich men walk home with slaves carrying torches.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: Juvenal says you'd be foolish to go out to dinner without first writing your will.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: Because from any open window above you, someone might throw out a broken pot.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: Or empty something much worse.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: At night, the streets belong to the wagons, the drunks, and the fires.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: Augustus created a corps of watchmen, the vigiles, to patrol the dark streets and fight fires.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: Up in his small room, our Roman lights a clay oil lamp, for a little while.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: Lamp oil costs money, so the evening is short.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: He goes to sleep. Down in the street, the wagons start rolling again.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: And in a few hours, before the roosters, the schoolmaster will start shouting.
cenas.nome_capitulo: A noite

cenas.texto: So, what did ancient Romans do all day?
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: They worked, mostly in the morning.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: They networked, every single morning.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: They ate, gossiped, wrote on walls, and went to the baths, almost every afternoon.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: And a surprising part of their day is still with us.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: The English word noon comes from the Latin nona hora: the ninth hour.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: It once meant mid-afternoon, and over the centuries it slid back to midday.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: Siesta comes from the sixth hour.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: And that hungry man in the Roman comedy, cursing the inventor of the sundial?
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: He sounds a lot like us, staring at a calendar full of meetings.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: All the sources for this video, from Martial to Seneca to the walls of Pompeii, are in the description.
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)

cenas.texto: And tell me in the comments: which Roman hour would you want to live in?
cenas.nome_capitulo: Fechamento (volta ao presente)
